description: Polls a HAPI FHIR or Smile OmniVera endpoint on an interval and pushes each returned resource downstream as JSON. Supports FHIR R4 and R5, and connects to an open test server, a bearer-token endpoint, a basic-auth server, or an OAuth2 Backend Services deployment.

config.label: Interval
config.description: How often, in milliseconds, to poll the FHIR server. 60000 is one minute.

config.label: FHIR Base URL
config.description: The FHIR base URL, with no trailing resource path. The public HAPI test server is https://hapi.fhir.org/baseR4 (or /baseR5). For Smile OmniVera, use the endpoint Smile supplied for your deployment and tenant.

config.label: FHIR Version
config.description: Which FHIR release this endpoint serves. Sent as the fhirVersion parameter on the Accept header. Advisory only: a server that hosts one release ignores it, so the base URL still has to point at the right release.

config.label: Authentication
config.description: How to authenticate. 'None' sends no Authorization header and suits the public HAPI test server or a local hapi-fhir-jpaserver. 'OAuth2 Backend Services' is the unattended flow a production Smile OmniVera endpoint normally expects. Only the fields for the mode you choose are used.

config.label: Token URL
config.description: OAuth2 only. The token endpoint to exchange credentials at. Leave empty to discover it from the FHIR base URL's .well-known/smart-configuration document; set it explicitly when the server does not publish one or its authorization server sits elsewhere.

config.label: Client ID
config.description: OAuth2 only. The client id issued for this integration.

config.label: Client Secret
config.description: OAuth2 only. The client secret issued for this integration. Stored encrypted and decrypted only when the script reads it.

config.label: Scope
config.description: OAuth2 only. Space-separated scopes to request, for example 'system/*.read' for read-only access or 'system/Patient.read system/Observation.read' to narrow it. Leave empty to let the server apply its default.

config.label: Bearer Token
config.description: Bearer Token mode only. A token issued outside this adapter. Stored encrypted. Note the adapter cannot refresh it, so a short-lived token will start failing when it expires - use OAuth2 for an unattended feed.

config.label: Username
config.description: Basic mode only. The username to send in the Authorization header.

config.label: Password
config.description: Basic mode only. The password to send in the Authorization header. Stored encrypted.

config.label: Resource Type
config.description: The FHIR resource type to search, for example Patient, Observation or Encounter.

config.label: Search Query
config.description: FHIR search parameters as a query string, for example 'family=Smith&birthdate=1970-01-01'. Use _count to set the page size and _lastUpdated to fetch only recent changes. Leave empty to return everything the server offers on the first page.

config.label: Max Pages
config.description: How many pages of search results to follow. A FHIR server returns one page plus a 'next' link, so 1 fetches only the first page. Raise it to walk further, or set 0 for no limit - be careful, an unfiltered search can be very large.

config.label: Live Mode
config.description: When off, requests are prepared and logged but never sent. Use it to confirm the URL and credentials are configured before touching a real server.

config.label: Verify TLS
config.description: Verify the server's TLS certificate. Leave on. Turn it off only for a local test server with a self-signed certificate.
